import hashlib,json,math,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from spacepdhcg.gtoc12.low_thrust import LegCertificate

def digest(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def record(path):

import hashlib,json,sys,os
from pathlib import Path
from contextlib import closing
import numpy as np
from test_gtoc12_gpu_qoco import coast_fixture
from spacepdhcg.gtoc12.gpu_qoco import GpuQocoProblem
from spacepdhcg.gtoc12.low_thrust import _Discretisation,_ConvexProblem
model,times,states,controls,boundary,weights=coast_fixture('zoh')
rows=[]
with closing(GpuQocoProblem(model,times,'zoh',False,False,boundary,weights,1e-9,ruiz_iterations=int(os.environ['COAST_RUIZ']))) as gpu:
 for repeat in range(3):
  trust=.1/(repeat+1); penalty=13.+repeat
  ok,label,x=gpu.solve_linearised(states,controls,8,trust,.3,penalty,.3,.05,.02,.001)
  disc=_Discretisation(model,times,8,'zoh');phi,psi,affine,_=disc.linearise(states,controls)
  a,b,q,_,p=_ConvexProblem(4,False,False).build(phi,psi,affine,disc.stencils,states,controls,boundary,trust,.3,penalty,.3,.05,.02,weights,.001,zero_last_control=True)
  slack=b-a@x;d=gpu.dimensions
  eq=float(np.max(np.abs(slack[:d.equalities])))
  inequality=float(np.min(slack[d.equalities:d.equalities+d.inequalities]))
  soc=slack[d.equalities+d.inequalities:].reshape(-1,4)
  soc_violation=float(np.max(np.linalg.norm(soc[:,1:],axis=1)-soc[:,0]))
  objective=float(q@x+x@p@x-.5*np.dot(p.diagonal(),x*x))
  report=gpu.last_report
  objective_difference=abs(objective-report['primal_objective']) if report['primal_objective'] is not None else float('inf')
  strict=bool(ok and eq<=1e-9 and inequality>=-1e-9 and soc_violation<=1e-9 and abs(x[27]-1)<=1e-5 and abs(objective)<=1e-7 and objective_difference<=1e-12)
  rows.append(dict(repeat=repeat,reported_qualified=ok,strict_qualified=strict,original_equality=eq,inequality_minimum=inequality,soc_violation=soc_violation,objective=objective,objective_difference=objective_difference,primal_sha256=hashlib.sha256(x.tobytes()).hexdigest(),primal=x.tolist(),report=report))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(qualified=sum(r['strict_qualified'] for r in rows),iterations=[r['report']['iterations'] for r in rows],equality=[r['original_equality'] for r in rows],hashes=[r['primal_sha256'][:12] for r in rows])))
